blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: With the growing need for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) and their applications to speech, challenges persist in summarizing and evaluating conversations that lack a clear end goal. We introduce SAUCE -- a reference-free, fact-based evaluation pipeline for cross-lingual conversational speech summarization. It measures the accuracy and the fact coverage of a summary through the entailment between conversation and text. We compare SAUCE against several popular summarization metrics and demonstrate the effectiveness of capturing information loss due to transcription and translation error and identifying broken summaries. Crucially, unlike black-box LLM evaluators or dense embedding metrics, SAUCE is inherently explainable: it maps summary scores to discrete, verifiable facts, allowing users to pinpoint exact hallucinations or omissions. We illustrate how this interpretability helps developers systematically profile LLM behaviors and gives end-users an actionable tool to verify summary accuracy in noisy, real-world conditions. Preliminary investigations show SAUCE strongly align with human judgment.
blocks.zh: 随着对大语言模型及其语音应用的评价需求日益增长,在总结和评价缺乏明确最终目标的对话方面仍然存在挑战。 我们介绍SAUCE -- -- 一个无参考、基于事实的评估程序,用于跨语言对话的演讲总结。 它通过对话与文本之间的必然关系,衡量摘要的准确性和事实覆盖面。 我们比较了SCUCE与几个流行的总结计量标准,并展示了记录因抄录和翻译错误而导致的信息损失以及识别断裂摘要的有效性. 关键是,与黑箱LLM评价器或密集嵌入度量衡不同,SAUCE本质上是可以解释的:它将汇总分数映射到离散的,可核实的事实,允许用户精确地确定准确的幻觉或遗漏. 我们说明这种可解释性如何帮助开发者系统地剖析LLM行为,并给予最终用户一个可操作的工具,以验证在吵闹的现实世界条件下的简要准确性. 初步调查显示SAUCE与人类判断非常一致.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Machine-generated summarization quality has rapidly improved with the advent of large language models (LLMs) and is commonly used by users for tasks like understanding research papers and generating meeting notes. In some cases, LLM-based summaries have been found to be more accurate than reference summaries in existing academic datasets Zhang et al. (2024) . Evaluation of summary quality remains a critical challenge, as there is no single true summary for a given document; instead, a distribution of possible summaries can be considered correct Jung et al. (2024) . Users also have their own preferences in terms of both style and content. Any variation in user preference would change the corresponding reference summary, making it impossible to generate sufficient reference summaries to encapsulate these variations. Most existing metrics and measurement pipelines lack the ability to provide quantitative analysis, making it difficult for end users to perform a systematic analysis of summary quality.
In the scenario of daily conversation—where the end goal and information - flow structure are often unclear—it becomes even harder to evaluate summary quality.
A quantitative measurement pipeline for such data will assist end users to efficiently evaluate summaries and provide developers with constructive direction for model selection and improvement.
blocks.zh:
随着大型语言模型(LLM)的出现,机器所生成的总结质量得到迅速提高,并被用户通常用于理解研究论文和生成会笔等任务. 在某些情况下,发现基于LLM的概要比现有学术数据集的参考概要更为准确 张等 (2024). 对摘要质量的评价仍然是一项重大挑战,因为某一文件没有一份真正的摘要;相反,可能的摘要的分发可被视为是正确的Jung等人(2024年)。 用户在风格和内容上也有自己的偏好. 用户偏好的任何变化都会改变相应的参考摘要,因此无法生成足够的参考摘要来概括这些变化. 大多数现有的计量和计量管道缺乏提供定量分析的能力,使最终用户难以对简要质量进行系统分析。
在日常对话的情景中——最终目标和信息——流动结构往往不明确——评价简要质量变得更加困难。
这些数据的定量计量程序将有助于终端用户有效地评价摘要,并为开发者提供选择和改进模型的建设性方向。

blocks.en: We believe that it is necessary to create quantitative reference-free evaluation metrics in order to accommodate the flexibility of the task. As with prior work, we agree that a single metric cannot capture all of the necessary dimensions Gehrmann et al. (2023) . When the scope and end goal are not clearly defined, we believe it is important for the summary to include as much key information as possible and be factually accurate, given the word limit. Therefore, we propose an evaluation pipeline—Summary Analysis Using Conversation Entailment (SAUCE), that captures two specific aspects of the summary: Faithfulness and Coverage, where faithfulness captures whether the information in the summary is supported by the text (factual accuracy) and coverage captures whether the important information in the text is captured by the summary (coverage of key information).
blocks.zh: 我们认为,有必要制定无参考量评价衡量标准,以适应任务的灵活性。 与先前的工作一样,我们同意,单一的衡量标准无法涵盖所有必要的层面Gehrmann等人(2023年)。 当范围和最终目标没有明确界定时,我们认为,鉴于字数限制,摘要必须尽可能地包括关键信息,并做到事实准确。 因此,我们建议建立一个评估程序——利用对话的配合进行简要分析(SAUCE),其中包含摘要的两个具体方面: 忠诚和覆盖,其中忠诚能捕捉摘要中的信息是否得到文本的支持(事实准确性),而覆盖能捕捉到文本中的重要信息是否被摘要所捕捉(关键信息的覆盖).

blocks.en: We consider the specific use case of evaluating cross-lingual conversational speech summarization. This is a challenging task where human-generated reference summaries do not exist. It’s also under-researched compared to traditional text problems. The content is less structured and goal-oriented, unlike meeting recordings or voice messages. Furthermore, conversational speech presents unique challenges beyond simply lacking a clear end goal. Spontaneous dialogues are riddled with disfluencies, speaker overlaps, and topic shifts. When these complexities are compounded by cascading errors from Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Machine Translation (MT), the semantic surface of the text is fundamentally altered. In these noisy conditions, a critical limitation of both traditional n-gram metrics and modern LLM-as-a-judge frameworks is their lack of explainability. When a summary receives a low score, end-users are left guessing whether the penalty stems from a hallucinated entity, a missed core topic, or a stylistic bias. A quantitative measurement pipeline must not only score a summary but also provide a transparent audit trail of why the summary succeeded or failed. SAUCE addresses this by providing a transparent, fact-by-fact ledger. Every score is entirely traceable to atomic facts, making the evaluation both interpretable and actionable.
blocks.zh: 我们考虑评价跨语言对话的言论总结的具体用途。 在没有人为生成的参考摘要的情况下,这是一项具有挑战性的任务。 与传统文字问题相比, 内容结构更简洁,目标导向更低,不同于会议录音或语音留言. 此外,谈话演说提出了独特的挑战,而不仅仅是缺乏明确的最终目标。 自发的对话充满了分歧、演讲者重叠和专题转移。 当这些复杂因素被自动语音识别(ASR)和机器翻译(MT)的连锁错误所加重时,文字的语义表面会被根本地改变. 在这些吵闹的情况下,传统正克度量衡和现代LLM-as-a-judge框架的关键限制是它们缺乏解释性。 当一个总结得到低分时,最终使用者会被留作猜测,惩罚是来自于一个被幻觉的实体,一个被错失的核心话题,还是结构偏差. 定量计量程序不仅必须得分汇总,而且还必须提供一份透明的审计线索,说明汇总成败的原因。 SCUCE通过提供透明、逐一的分类账来解决这个问题。 每个分数都完全可以追溯到原子事实,使评价既可解释又可采取行动。

blocks.en:
Our contributions are to provide a summarization evaluation pipeline that can:
1) effectively evaluate cross-lingual conversations in the presence of ASR and MT errors, 2) score factually without human annotation and 3) provide interpretability and quality measurement when the end goal of the text is not clearly defined.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献是提供一个总结评价程序,以便:
1)在ASR和MT出错的情况下,有效评价跨语言对话,2)在没有人名注释的情况下实事求是地得分,3)在文本最终目标没有明确定义时提供可解释性和质量衡量.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: The two major directions for summarization evaluation are reference-based and reference-free . Reference-based metrics are the more traditional approach and require one or more reference summaries—typically generated by humans—for comparison. ROUGE Lin (2004) and BERTScore Zhang et al. (2019) are popular examples. They compute a similarity score for matching word units or tokens, sentence by sentence between the candidate summary and reference summary. While widely used in the community, research shows they only measure topic presence rather than factual accuracy in the summary Deutsch and Roth (2021) . ROUGE is also not sensitive enough to the impact of major errors in the input, like those from ASR or MT errors Nelson et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 总结评价的两个主要方向是参考和无参考。 基于参考的衡量标准是比较传统的方法,需要一份或多份参考摘要——通常是由人类生成的——来进行比较。 ROUGE LIN(2004)和BERTScore Zhang等(2019)都是受欢迎的例子. 他们计算出一个相似的分数,用于匹配词单位或符号,在候选摘要和参考摘要之间逐句计算. 虽然在社区中被广泛使用,但研究表明它们只测量专题的存在,而不是摘要"德意志"和"罗斯"(2021)中的事实准确性. ROUGE对输入中的重大出错的影响也不够敏感,如ASR或MT出错Nelson等(2024).

blocks.en: Due to both the limitations and the difficulties of reference-based approaches, a number of reference-free metrics have been proposed as well. One general line of work is on measuring factual consistency through text entailment. Text entailment, as known as Natural Language Inference (NLI), measures how the hypothesis and generated text align or contradict each other. SummaC Laban et al. (2022) , a popular example, measures the coherence between the document and summary by segmenting the document into sentence units and scoring document and summary sentence pairs with text entailment models. Its better performing variant SummaC Conv is heavily trained on a specific text domain, which may not generalize to our cross-lingual conversation setting. FENICE extends the evaluation capability to long-form text summarization with claim extraction and entailment, follow by coreference resolution Scirè et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 由于基于参考方法的局限性和困难,也提出了一些无参考指标。 一项一般的工作是通过文本衡量事实一致性。 文本引出,被称作"自然语言推论"(NLI),用来衡量假说和生成的文本是如何对齐或相矛盾的. SummaC Laban等人(2022年)是一个受欢迎的例子,通过将文件分入句子单位和打分文件和提要句配对并配以文本内涵模型,衡量文件与提要的一致性。 其性能较好的变体SummaC Conv在特定的文本域上受到大量训练,可能不会被概括到我们跨语言的对话设置上. FENICE将评价能力扩大到长式文本的汇总,并附有索赔提取和要求,随后与Scirè等决议(2024年)相参照。

blocks.en:
Another approach to reference-free evaluation is to directly use LLMs for scoring Akkasi et al. (2023) , such as GPTScore Fu et al. (2024) . This "LLM-as-a-judge" paradigm typically involves prompting high-capacity models like GPT-4 to evaluate summaries across various dimensions of interest. G-Eval Liu et al. (2023) pioneered this by using chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting to align model scores with human judgment, while Prometheus Kim et al. (2023) and JudgeLM Zhu et al. (2023) introduced fine-tuned, open-source alternatives designed for reproducibility. FineSurE Song et al. (2024) extends the work to include LLM to extract key facts for LLM scoring.
While these frameworks can provide qualitative explanations, they are difficult to interpret quantitatively and become computationally infeasible when scaling to the massive/gigantic datasets typical of real-world applications. Furthermore, these evaluators are susceptible to significant systematic biases, self-preference bias Panickssery et al. (2024) , verbosity bias, where longer summaries are unfairly favored Hu et al. (2024) , and a recently identified overlap bias where LLMs increasingly favor AI-generated summaries over human-written ones Fang et al. (2026) . Most critically, LLM judges often overlook granular factual contradictions in favor of surface-level fluency Chen et al. (2024) ; Fu et al. (2024) , which further motivates our need for the explicit, fact-extraction and entailment pipeline proposed in this work. Fact checking of the extracted facts against an external knowledge database is not in the scope of this work.
blocks.zh:
另一种无参考评价方法是直接使用LLMs来评分Akkasi等人(2023年),例如GPTScore Fu等人(2024年). 这种“LLM-as-a-judge”范式通常涉及促使GPT-4等高能模型评价各方面感兴趣的摘要。 G-Eval Liu等人(2023年)通过使用"思维链"(CoT)来促使模型分数与人类判断一致,而Prometheus Kim等人(2023年)和Judge LM Zhu等人则开创了这个过程. (2023)引入了为可再生产而设计的微调开源替代品. 精细 Song等 (2024)将作品扩展至包括LLM,为LLM评分提取关键事实.
虽然这些框架可以提供定性解释,但当缩放到现实世界应用典型的大规模/巨型数据集时,它们很难进行定量解释并变得无法计算。 此外,这些评价人员还容易出现重大的系统性偏见、自我偏好偏好Panicksery等人(2024年)、动词偏好(2024年),长期摘要不公平地偏好Hu等人(2024年),以及最近发现的重叠偏好(2026年),因为LLMs越来越倾向于AI生成的摘要,而不是人文摘要Fang等人(2026年)。 最关键的是,LLM法官往往忽略了表面流利的表面事实矛盾。 Chen等人(2024年);Fu等人(2024年),这进一步激发了我们对这一工作中提出的明确、事实和必然的管道的需求。 根据外部知识数据库对所取出的事实进行事实检查不属于这项工作的范围。

blocks.en: 3 Proposed approach
blocks.zh: 3 拟议办法

blocks.en: SAUCE evaluates faithfulness and coverage of the summary with 2 metrics: SAUCE Faithful and SAUCE Coverage . SAUCE Faithful measures the percentage of summary facts entailed by the conversation and SAUCE Coverage measures the percentage of conversation facts covered in the summary. It can be seen as an agentic workflow that uses an LLM to extract key information from the text.
blocks.zh: SCUCE以2个标准评价摘要的忠诚性和覆盖面: SAUCE 忠实和SAUCE报道. 绍 斯 忠实地衡量谈话所涉的即决事实的百分比,而SCUCE的覆盖面则衡量摘要所涉的即决事实的百分比。 它可被看作一种代理工作流程,它使用LLM从文本中取出关键信息.

blocks.en: 3.1 Pipeline Design
blocks.zh: 3.1 管道设计

blocks.en: Figure 1: Workflow of the SAUCE. The user can access the fact-text pairs to understand the missing or wrong information in the summary with corresponding faithfulness and coverage scores.
blocks.zh: 图1 常设委员会的工作流程。 用户可以访问事实文本配对,以了解摘要中缺失或错误的信息,并有相应的忠诚度和覆盖分数.

blocks.en: SAUCE consists of fact extraction followed by text entailment. Illustrated in Figure 1 , we first extract atomic facts from the conversation/summary with GPT-4o (gpt-4o-2024-08-06), then determine if the facts are entailed by the summary/conversation using DeBERTa-v3 (deberta-v3-large-mnli). While LLMs are prone to hallucination, they have been shown to outperform other models with about 90% accuracy in the task of fact extraction Polak and Morgan (2024) ; Dagdelen et al. (2024) . Our internal evaluation found the extracted facts to be over 98% accurate. We use DeBERTa-v3 as the text entailment model because of its state - of - the - art performance in this task He et al. (2021) and its limited computational requirements.
blocks.zh: SAUCE包括事实提取,然后是文本衍生。 图1中,我们首先从与GPT-4o(gpt-4o-2024-08-06)的对话/总结中提取出原子事实,然后用DeBERTa-v3(deberta-v3-great-mnli)确定这些事实是否由摘要/对话所引起. 虽然LLMS容易产生幻觉,但事实证明它们比其他模型要好,在提取Polak和Morgan(2024年)的事实任务中准确度约为90%;Dagdelen等人(2024年). 我们内部评估发现,提取的事实准确度超过98%。 我们使用DeBERTa-v3作为文本的引出模型,因为它在这项任务中的艺术表现(He等(2021年)及其有限的计算要求。

blocks.en: To calculate SAUCE Faithful , after extracting all the facts in the summary, the facts are scored against chunks of the conversation, with 5 lines of conversation per chunk. If a fact-to-chunk pair scores higher than a threshold, then the fact is considered to be entailed by the conversation. The score is calculated as the proportion of matched facts. We also experimented with entailing summary facts against facts extracted from the conversation, but found that the proposed fact - to - chunk approach yields significantly better performance.
blocks.zh: 计算 SAUCE 忠实地说,在总结了所有事实之后, 事实的分数是, 如果一对事实对一的分数高于一个阈值,那么这个事实就被认为是对话引起的. 得分按相匹配事实的比例计算. 我们还试验了将简要事实与对话中提取的事实相提并论,但发现拟议中的事实 -- -- 逐块地 -- -- 产生了显著更好的业绩。

blocks.en: For SAUCE Coverage , we ask the LLM to only extract the N most important facts from the conversation, where N is defined by the length and desired content compression rate of the task. We do not ask for all the facts in the conversations because the LLM will frequently generate over 100 facts from a 10-minute recording, defeating the purpose of summarizing the conversation. Importance is subjective, but in the case of a topic-defined conversation, the LLM can be guided towards preferring certain topics and information through prompting. To overcome the nondeterministic output from the LLM, we extract the N most important facts 5 separate times and concatenate the list for scoring. We also assume that facts that are selected multiple times are more likely to be important. For text entailment, each fact is scored against each line of the summary. This score is calculated as the proportion of matched facts.
blocks.zh: 绍克 覆盖,我们要求LLM只从对话中提取N最重要的事实,其中N是由任务的长度和所期望的内容压缩率来定义的. 我们并不要求谈话中的所有事实,因为LLM会经常从10分钟的录音中产生100多个事实,从而辜负总结谈话的目的. 重要性是主观的,但就专题界定的对话而言,LLM可以通过提示引导偏好某些专题和信息. 为了克服LLM的非定型输出,我们提取N最重要的事实5次分别取出并整理出评分列表. 我们还认为,多次挑选的事实更有可能是重要的。 就文字含义而言,每项事实都与摘要的每行对照。 此分数为相匹配事实的比例.

blocks.en: A key advantage of SAUCE is its transparent by-product: the fact ledger. Rather than outputting a single opaque float value, the system surfaces the exact list of atomic facts that were successfully entailed and those that were contradicted or unsupported. For end-users, this ledger acts as a rapid verification tool to check a summary against the source without re-reading the entire transcript. For developers, it isolates errors of hallucinations, captured by unentailed summary facts, from errors of omission (missing key topics, captured by unentailed conversation facts).
blocks.zh: SAUCE的一个关键优势是它的透明副产品:事实分类账. 该系统没有输出出单一不透明的浮点值,而是表出成功的原子事实和相互矛盾或不支持的事实的确切清单。 对于最终用户来说,这一分类账作为快速核查工具,在不重新阅读全部记录的情况下对照来源检查汇总. 对于开发者来说,它将幻觉错误,被不详细摘要事实所捕获,从遗漏错误中分离出(遗漏了关键话题,被不详细谈话事实所捕获出).

blocks.en: 3.2 Performance on Conversation Entailment
blocks.zh: 3.2 对话的配合性表现

blocks.en: Fact-to-fact (sentence-to-sentence) entailment has been widely studied in the text community. However, much of the work has focused on written text as opposed to conversational speech. In order to verify whether DeBERTa-v3 is suitable for fact-to-conversation entailment, we evaluate the setup on a publicly available conversation entailment dataset from MSU Zhang and Chai (2009) . It consists of hypothesis statements and supporting conversation chunks from Switchboard 1 1 1 https://catalog.ldc.upenn.edu/LDC97S62 extracted by human annotators. Conversation entailment is a challenging problem; only half of all the statements MSU collected are agreed upon by all annotators. Based on our internal analysis, we found many instances where the entailment was questionable, or the statements were only entailed when considering the conversation as a whole.
blocks.zh: 文字界广泛研究了事实对事实(判决对判决)的影响。 然而,大部分作品都专注于书面文字,而不是对话演说. 为了核实DeBERTa-v3是否适合进行事实与对话,我们评价了由MSU Zhang和Chai(2009年)提供的公开对话数据集的设置。 它包括假说和来自Switchboard 1 1的辅助对话块 https://catalog.ldc.upenn.edu/LDC97S62 由人类注释者提取. 对话是一个具有挑战性的问题;所收集的所有陈述中只有一半得到所有注释者的同意。 根据我们的内部分析,我们发现,许多情况下所涉问题值得怀疑,或者只有在将谈话作为一个整体考虑时才会作出陈述。

blocks.en: We set up two experiments to evaluate our conversation entailment setup. First, we directly entail the conversation chunks and statements in the dataset with DeBERTa-v3. Second, we take the whole conversation that each chunk belongs to and run our SAUCE Faithful scoring on it; the most entailed conversation chunks are scored. We experimented with a threshold of 0.9, 0.95 and 0.98. Results are shown in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们建立了两个实验 来评估我们的对话设置。 首先,我们直接涉及与DeBERTa-v3的数据集中的对话块和语句. 其次,我们把每一块都属于我们的全部对话,并进行我们的SAUCE信仰评分;最涉及的对话块被评分。 我们试验了0.9,0.95和0.98的阈值. 结果见表1。

blocks.en: Table 1: Accuracy rate (%) on conversation entailment. Ent. - entailed pairs, NoEnt. - non-entailed pairs.
blocks.zh: 表1:对话的准确率(%)。 - 成对,无尾对。

blocks.en: Table 2: Examples of non-entailed pairs that are mis-classified as entailed. The first row confuses factual and hypothetical scenarios, which is also confusing to humans. Second row confuses the subject, the speaker vs. the person indicated by ‘he’.
blocks.zh: 表2:被误归类为包含的非尾配对的例子. 第一行混淆了事实和假设情景,这也令人类困惑. 第二行混淆了话题,演讲者与由"他"指名的人.

blocks.en: Non-entailed pairs have worse performance than entailed pairs. Most of the mis-entailed statements are those where the tenses or identities of speakers are swapped (see Table 2 ). This reflects that even with acceptable performance, text entailment models are not tailored made for conversations entailment. We also noticed the dataset has annotation issues; some of the selected conversation chunks from the entailed pairs do not support the statement in the data, but other parts of the conversation do support the statement. For the remainder of our study, we select a threshold of 0.9 as we believe it is more critical to correctly detect entailed pair when it is present.
blocks.zh: 非尾配对的性能比所带配对差. 发言内容不准确的大多是发言者的紧张或身份被互换(见表2)。 这反映出,即使具有可接受的性能,文本涵义模型也不适合对话涵义。 我们也注意到数据集有注释问题;从所包含对子中选择的部分对口块不支持数据中的语句,但对话的其他部分确实支持该语句. 在我们的研究的其余部分,我们选择了0.9的阈值,因为我们认为,更关键的是,当结合成对存在时,正确检测成对。

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation of metrics on summarized ASR+MT conversations
blocks.zh: 页:1 总结ASR+MT对话的衡量标准评价

blocks.en: To evaluate our proposed metrics, we analyze performance on a number of scenarios. The first evaluation is to compare the performance on the conversational speech summarization task with transcription and translation errors.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们提议的衡量标准,我们分析了若干设想方案的执行情况。 第一项评价是将谈话语音总结任务的表现与抄写和翻译错误进行比较.

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en:
We experiment on conversational telephone speech (CTS) across 4 languages, Arabic, Spanish, Mandarin and Russian. Audio and transcripts are available through the LDC (Linguistic Data Consortium) for all languages. CallHome 2 2 2 https://catalog.ldc.upenn.edu/{LDC97T19, LDC97S45} is used for Arabic, CallHome 3 3 3 https://catalog.ldc.upenn.edu/{LDC96T17, LDC96S35} and Fisher 4 4 4 https://github.com/joshua-decoder/fisher-callhome-corpus for Spanish, HUB5 5 5 5 https://catalog.ldc.upenn.edu/LDC98S69 for Mandarin and
Mixer 3 Speech 6 6 6 https://catalog.ldc.upenn.edu/LDC2023S02 for Russian. Crowd-sourced English translations are publicly available for Arabic Kumar et al. (2014) and Spanish Post et al. (2013) .
Mandarin Wotherspoon et al. (2024) and Russian are our in-house translations.
Each conversation is 10 minutes long in average. The selection of CTS data fits the domain of loosely defined and structured conversation, which SAUCE is designed to handle. CallHome and CallFriend corpora contain conversations with family and friends. There are no clearly defined goals and speakers can discuss anything. The Fisher corpus defines topics to discuss, but there is no requirement for the speakers to come to any conclusion.

blocks.en: 4.2 Experiment setup
blocks.zh: 4.2 实验设置

blocks.en:
Summary: We prompt GPT-4o to generate a 200-word summary for each conversation.
We specifically prompt the model to generate concise and comprehensive summaries with clarity, based only on the provided conversation and to include the main ideas and essential information.
We experimented with a range of prompts, but they have a limited impact on the overall quality of the summaries when there is no topic specified.
We tested various word limits ranging from 50, 100, 200 and 500 words, and found 200 words to be a good balance considering the length of the conversation and readability to a human user. The LLM is forced to downselect information included in the summary.
blocks.zh:
摘要:我们请GPT-4o为每次谈话生成200字摘要.
我们特别促使这一模式只根据所提供的谈话,以明确的方式编写简明而全面的摘要,并列入主要想法和基本信息。
我们试验了各种提示,但在没有具体说明专题的情况下,这些提示对摘要的整体质量影响有限。
我们测试了50个,100个,200个和500个字的各种字词限制,发现200个字是很好的平衡,考虑到对话的长度和对人类使用者的可读性. LLM被迫下调摘要中包含的信息.

blocks.en: ASR+MT pipeline: We use a cascaded ASR+MT pipeline to obtain the English conversations for summarization containing ASR+MT errors. We use Whisper-large-v3 Radford et al. (2023) for ASR and NLLB-200-distilled-1.3B Costa-jussà et al. (2022) for MT. Both models are fine-tuned with the training set of each specific language. While we use a cascaded approach for the purpose of measuring the impact of ASR and MT errors, our metrics would be equally applicable to direct speech summarization approaches Shang et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: ASR+MT管道: 我们使用一个分级ASR+MT管道来获取包含ASR+MT出错的英语对白. 我们使用Whisper-large-v3 Radford等人(2023年)来进行ASR和NLLB-200-distilled-1.3B. Costa-jussà等(2022年)用于MT. 两种模式都根据每种特定语言的培训组合进行了微调。 虽然我们采用级联方法来衡量ASR和MT错误的影响,但我们的衡量标准同样适用于Sang等人的直接语音总结方法(2024年)。

blocks.en: Evaluation: All the dev and test sets of each language are used for evaluation. We set N=20 for conversation fact extraction for evaluating 200 words summary. We compared our metrics along with SummaC and FENICE, NLI-based metrics that is similar with SAUCE, as well as LLM-as-judge metrics: G-EVAL and FineSurE.
blocks.zh: 评价: 每种语言的所有dev和测试集都用于评价. 我们设定N=20用于对话事实提取,用于评价200个单词摘要. 我们与SummaC和FENICE、与SAUCE相似的NLI计量以及LLM-as-judge的计量:G-EVAL和FineSurE进行了比较。

blocks.en:
For our metrics, each summary is scored against their ground truth conversation chunks for SAUCE Faithful and facts extracted from the ground truth conversation for SAUCE Coverage .
All the other metrics score the summary according to how their pipelines are setup, either against the ground truth conversation (SummaC, G-EVAL) or its extracted facts (FENICE, FineSurE).
For SummaC, we used the recommended SummaC Conv (Convolution of the NLI sentence pair matrix) and the traditional SummaC ZS (Zero-Short model). To ensure a fair evaluation on conversation entailment, we expanded the granularity to 5 sentences to match our SAUCE Faithful scoring setup.
blocks.zh:
我们的衡量标准是,每份摘要都与 SAUCE 信仰的地面真相对话内容相匹配,
所有其他衡量标准都根据其管道的设置方式对摘要进行评分,或者与地面真相对话(SummaC,G-EVAL)或者其提取出的事实(FENICE, FineSurE)作对.
对于SummaC,我们使用了所推荐的SummaC Conv(NLI句对矩阵的演化)和传统的SummaC ZS(Zero-Short模型). 为了确保对对话的公平评价,我们把颗粒度扩大到了5个句子,以配合我们的SAUCE忠心积分设定。

blocks.en: 4.3 Results on summary evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 总结评价结果

blocks.en: We present the average of the ASR and MT scores in WER (Word Error Rate, the lower the better) and BLEU along with the summary scores on the ground truth, MT and ASR+MT translations in Figure 2 . Breakdown of the scores are in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了WER(Word出错率,越低越好)和BLEU的ASR和MT分数的平均值,以及图2中的实地真象、MT和ASR+MT等的汇总分数。 分数细目见附录B.1。

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Comparison with NLI-based metrics
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 与基于NLI的计量比较

blocks.en: Figure 2: Mean WER and BLEU scores of each language, and their summary scores on ground truth, MT and ASR+MT English transcriptions. We present the plots in orange for SAUCE, blue for NLI-based metrics, purple for LLM-as-judge metrics.
blocks.zh: 图2:每种语言的平均WER和BLEU的分数,及其在地面真实,MT和ASR+MT英语的分数汇总. 我们用橙色表示SAUCE的地块,用蓝色表示NLI的度量衡,用紫色表示LLM-as-judge的度量衡。

blocks.en: Among the NLI-based metrics, SAUCE is the only metric that have a consistent drop when MT and ASR+MT errors are introduced, while the SummaC metrics do not have a consistent pattern on different languages, and FENICE has very limited degradation especially on Spanish.
blocks.zh: 在基于NLI的度量中,SAUCE是唯一一个在MT和ASR+时持续下降的度量. MT出错被引入,而SummaC的度量衡在不同的语言上没有一致的规律,而FENICE的降解度非常有限,特别是在西班牙语上.

blocks.en:
Given the high WER and its contribution to a large drop in BLEU (8-12% absolute), we expect a large impact on summarization quality. SAUCE Coverage is nearly cut in half when both ASR and MT errors are introduced—reflecting the fact that GPT-4o has difficulty extracting information with the degradation in transcription accuracy and translation quality—while there is no significant impact on SummaC Conv,ZS and FENICE.
SAUCE Faithful and FENICE are more consistent and maintain a score of 90+%, regardless of the quality of the input. Based on our investigation, we find that GPT-4o generates more generic summaries in the presence of these errors. The lost of information is captured by SAUCE Coverage . However, FENICE lacks a "Coverage" metric, making it blind to omitted information, only very limited degradation is observed with the errors introduced.
blocks.zh:
鉴于WER的高水平及其对BLEU(绝对值为8-12%)大幅下降的贡献,我们期望对总和质量产生巨大影响. 绍 斯 在引入ASR和MT两个错误时,覆盖范围几乎被缩小了一半,这反映出GPT-4o难以从抄录精度和翻译质量的下降中提取信息,而对SummaC Conv、ZS和FENICE没有重大影响。
绍 斯 忠实和FENICE更加一致,无论输入的质量如何,保持了90分的分数. 根据我们的调查,我们发现,GPT-4o在出现这些错误时会产生更通用的摘要. 所失去的信息由 SAUCE 覆盖。 然而,FENICE缺乏"Coverage"的衡量标准,使得它盲目地忽略了信息,随着引入了错误,只能观察到非常有限的降解.

blocks.en: SummaC Conv sees a 40-60% absolute difference between Spanish and the other three languages. We suspect the large shift is due to differences in linguistic structure and word usage compare. SummaC is primary designed for written text and might not perform well on conversational style data, especially in languages that differ significantly from the training data.
blocks.zh: 汇总C Conv认为西班牙语与其他三种语言的绝对差别为40%-60%. 我们怀疑,大转变是由于语言结构和文字使用比较的不同。 SummaC是主要针对书面文本设计的,在对话风格数据上可能表现不佳,特别是在与培训数据相去甚远的语言上.

blocks.en: Both SummaC and FENICE adopt a stricter NLI-based pipeline to avoid LLM errors, but their traditional NLP models and mechanisms, which were built on structured text, completely break down when confronted with the disfluencies, speaker overlaps, and ASR/MT errors typical of natural speech.
blocks.zh: 两种语句 C和FENICE采用了更严格的以NLI为基础的管道来避免LLM出错,但是他们传统的NLP模式和机制建立在结构化的文本上,在面对出错,演讲者重叠,以及自然语音所典型的ASR/MT出错时完全崩溃.

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Comparison with LLM-as-judge metrics
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 与作为法官的LLM计量比较

blocks.en:
Compared with G-EVAL and FineSurE, consistent degradation is observed in all metrics under MT and ASR errors, except for G-EVAL’s consistency in Arabic and Spanish.
LLM-as-a-judge frameworks like G-EVAL and FineSurE act as computationally expensive "black boxes" that are highly susceptible to biases and tend to favor surface-level fluency over strict factual accuracy, making it difficult to trace exactly why a score was given. Even though FineSurE attempts to ground its evaluation by extracting key facts, it still ultimately depends on the LLM’s inherent reasoning to output a score. Additionally, FineSurE specifically suffers from an empirical flaw in its alignment logic (As shown in figure 2 ): when evaluating a Ground Truth (GT) summary against key facts extracted from that exact same GT summary, the LLM fails to score a perfect 100% in faithfulness, proving that using an LLM to judge semantic alignment is inherently unreliable. The 100% completeness across all languages, which implies that all key information is included in the GT summaries, seems unrealistic. This is because information is inevitably omitted during summarization, especially in long conversations (e.g., those lasting 30 minutes in the Mandarin dataset). SAUCE resolves these issues by using LLMs only for robust fact extraction and a dedicated NLI model for strict entailment, yielding a transparent, fact-by-fact ledger that reliably measures both faithfulness and coverage despite heavy noise. For the complete dataset and granular sub-metric scoring, see Table 7 in the Appendix.
blocks.zh:
与G-EVAL和FineSurE相比,除G-EVAL的阿拉伯文和西班牙文一致性外,在MT和ASR误差下的所有度量中都观察到持续退化.
G-EVAL和FineSurE等LLM-as-a-judge框架在计算上起到昂贵的"黑盒"作用,极易被偏见所左右并倾向于地表流利而不是严格的事实准确性,因此难以准确追踪给出分数的原因. 尽管FineSurE试图通过取出关键事实作为评价的依据,但它最终仍然取决于LLM的内在推理来输出分数. 此外,FineSurE在校正逻辑(如图2所示)中特别存在经验性缺陷:在根据完全相同的GT摘要中得出的关键事实评价地表真象(GT)摘要时,LLM未能百分百的忠实度得分,证明使用LLM判断语义校正本身是不可靠的. 所有语文的100%完整性似乎不现实,这意味着所有关键信息都包含在GT摘要中。 这是因为信息在汇总过程中不可避免地被省略了,特别是在长篇对话中(如普通话数据集中持续了30分钟的信息). SCUCE解决这些问题的方法是,只使用LLMs来进行强力的事实提取,并采用专用的NLI模式来严格进行处理,生成一个透明、逐个事实的分类账,可靠地衡量忠实程度和覆盖度,尽管噪音很大。 关于完整的数据集和颗粒子测量分数,见附录表7。

blocks.en: 4.4 Analysis on summaries
blocks.zh: 4.4 对摘要的分析

blocks.en:
We selected conversation sp_1578 from Spanish CallHome and listed the summaries and SAUCE and SummaC scores in Table 3 . There is a constant drop in SAUCE Coverage and some degradation in SAUCE Faithful when errors are introduced. The SummaC Conv, ZS metrics do not show the degradation consistently.
We highlight a few sentences, denoted with letters for comparison. The quality of the summary degrades across versions; the overall description of topics in (a) becomes more generic, which is still accurate (match on SAUCE Faithful ) but loses some information (drop in SAUCE Coverage ). Facts are also distorted due to transcription and translation errors, causing drop in both SAUCE Faithful and SAUCE Coverage . For example, (b) Carlos did not receive assistance is distorted to not receiving attention in the MT version to himself showing a lack of interest in ASR+MT. (c) Ernesto, from “buying a car and learning to drive" to “planning to purchase a car" with ASR+MT errors. The connection between facts also disappears due to ASR+MT errors, as in (d), which does not hurt SAUCE Faithful but hurts SAUCE Coverage when the facts that look for correlations between incidents are missing. For example of conversation facts used for scoring, see Appendix B.2 . The metrics make the impact of these cascading errors highly interpretable. When faced with ASR+MT degradation, we observe that the LLM often adopts a conservative generation strategy. It retreats to producing generic, high-level statements that remain factually accurate (maintaining high faithfulness) but strips away the granular, nuanced details of the conversation (causing a sharp drop in coverage). Traditional metrics like SummaC obfuscate this behavioral shift, whereas our fact-level mapping explicitly diagnoses it.
blocks.zh:
我们从西班牙的CallHome中选择了 sp_1578 并且将摘要以及 SAUCE 和 SummaC 的分数列在表3中。 在引入错误时,SAUCE的覆盖率不断下降,而SAUCE的忠诚程度有所降低。 SummaC Conv, ZS的度量标准不能一致地显示降解情况.
我们强调几句话,用字母表示,以便进行比较。 概要的质量在各种版本中都有所退化;(a)中对主题的总体描述变得更加笼统,它仍然准确(在SAUCE Faithful上相匹配),但失去了一些信息(在SAUCE的覆盖中倒下. 事实也因抄写和翻译错误而扭曲,导致SAUCE Faithful和SAUCE的覆盖范围下降。 例如,(b) Carlos没有得到援助被扭曲为在MT版本中得不到注意,以致自己对ASR+MT缺乏兴趣。 (c) Ernesto,从“购买一辆车并学会驾驶”到“计划购买一辆车”,有ASR+MT错误。 事实之间的联系也因ASR+MT错误而消失,如(d)中的错误,这并不会伤害SAUCE的信仰,而是会伤害SAUCE的覆盖范围,因为寻找事件相互关系的事实缺失. 例如,用于打分的对话事实,见附录B.2。 衡量标准使得这些连锁错误的影响具有高度的解释性. 当面临ASR+MT退化时,我们观察到LLM经常采取保守的生成策略. 它退而发表一般的,高层次的言论,这些言论在事实上仍然准确(保持高度的忠诚),但删除了对话的细微细节(导致报道锐减)。 传统的度量衡,如SummaC, 模糊了这个行为转变, 而我们的事实水平绘图 明确诊断它。

blocks.zh: 表3:西班牙对话摘要和得分(sp_1578)地面真相,与MT,ASR+MT错误. 与同一组事实相關的句子有颜色并用相应的字母标注.

blocks.en: 4.5 Experiment on metrics correlation
blocks.zh: 4.5 计量相关性实验

blocks.en: We also evaluate the correlation of the conversation quality and metrics at the document level. We believe that with ASR and MT errors introduced, the quality of the transcription should degrade so as the summary quality. Therefore, we measured the Kendall pair-wise rank correlation coefficient Abdi (2007) of ground truth and ASR+MT summary pairs against the metrics, assuming more error corresponds to worse summary quality, thus lower scores. In Table 4 , SAUCE Faithful and SAUCE Coverage are highly correlated with conversation quality, with SAUCE Coverage being more correlated than SAUCE Faithful . While SummaC Conv,ZS shows little to no correlation.
blocks.zh: 我们还评估在文件一级对话质量和衡量标准之间的相互关系。 我们认为,随着ASR和MT错误的出现,抄录的质量应当与摘要质量一样下降。 因此,我们对照衡量标准衡量了地面真理的肯德尔双向排名系数Abdi(2007年)和ASR+MT汇总对,假设更多的错误与汇总质量相对应,因此得分较低。 在表4中,SAUCE的忠实和SAUCE的覆盖率与对话质量高度相关,而SAUCE的覆盖率比SAUCE的忠诚要高。 SummaC Conv, ZS 显示的几乎不相关.

blocks.zh: 表4:实地真相和ASR+MT对话的度量系数。 假设从地面真理生成的摘要比从ASR+MT产出生成的摘要要好.

blocks.en: 5 Broken summary evaluation
blocks.zh: 5 中断的总结评价

blocks.en: 6 Evaluation of off-the-shelf LLMs
blocks.zh: 6 评价现成的有限责任管理

blocks.en: Lastly, we would like to know, given a set of models to choose from, how SAUCE can help end users to understand the models’ behaviors and identify a suitable model for their tasks.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们想知道,如果有一套模型可以选择,SAUCE如何能够帮助终端用户了解模型的行为,并确定适合他们任务的模型。

blocks.en: 6.1 Experiment Setup
blocks.zh: 6.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We compare various existing LLMs using our proposed metrics, namely GPT-4o, Mistral7B-instruct-v0.3, DeepSeek-R1 Guo et al. (2025) and its distilled version using the Qwen2.5 model Hui et al. (2024) (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B). We experimented with various prompts on different models, but maintained the same prompt in Section 4 to generate 200-word summaries from ground truth conversations because the difference in summary style across prompts is not significant.
blocks.zh: 我们使用我们提议的衡量标准,即GPT-4o、Mistral7B-instruct-v0.3、DeepSeek-R1 Guo等(2025)和采用Quen2.5模型Hui等(2024)(DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-14B)进行各种现有有限责任公司比较。 我们在不同的模型上试验了各种提示,但在第4节中维持同样的提示,从地面真相对话中生成200个字的总结,因为各种提示的总结风格差别不大.

blocks.en: 6.2 Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 6.2 结果和分析

blocks.en: Figure 4: SAUCE Faithful and SAUCE Coverage on 4 LLMs across 4 languages translated into English.
blocks.zh: 图4: SAUCE 忠诚和SAUCE 覆盖4种语言的法学硕士课程,翻译成英语。

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows the average SAUCE Faithful and SAUCE Coverage of four off - the - shelf LLMs across English translated from four languages. GPT - 4o achieves the highest SAUCE Faithful , while DeepSeek attains the highest SAUCE Coverage . Coverage degrades after distilling DeepSeek - R1 to a smaller 14B model. Surprisingly, DeepSeek - R1’s SAUCE Faithful is the lowest, even lower than its distilled variant. SAUCE Coverage of GPT-4o is less than that of a much smaller Mistral - 7B and is sometimes only comparable to DeepSeek - 14B in Arabic and Mandarin. These results suggest that DeepSeek - R1 is less accurate than its distilled version, and although GPT - 4o produces the most accurate summaries, they cover less detail than those of other models.
blocks.zh: 图4显示由四种语言翻译的全英语言中平均包含4种语言的课外课程。 GPT - 4o实现最高的SAUCE信仰,而DeepSeek获得最高的SAUCE覆盖. 在将DeepSeek - R1蒸馏出后,覆盖范围会降解为更小的14B型. 令人惊讶的是,DeepSeek - R1的SAUCE 忠诚是最低的,甚至低于其蒸馏变体. 绍 斯 GPT-4o的覆盖范围小于更小的米斯特拉尔-7B,有时仅可与DeepSeek-14B的阿拉伯语和普通话相比. 这些结果表明,DeepSeek - R1与其蒸馏版本相比不够准确,虽然GPT - 4o生成最准确的总结,但它们的涵盖范围比其他模型的要少.

blocks.en:
We analyzed the summaries and identified several model behaviors that explain the observed scores (detailed examples and analysis are in Appendix Section C ).
Misspellings and incorrect information lower faithfulness, while omitting subject details reduces coverage. We observed that GPT-4o summarizes the information both globally and locally; specific statements are compressed into more generic wording. This aligns with its high SAUCE Faithful but lower SAUCE Coverage . In contrast, Mistral7B and DeepSeek-R1 tend to preserve specific wording, producing extractive - like summaries. However, hallucination occurs more often, introducing misinterpreted details or information that never appeared in the conversation. This reflects the higher SAUCE Coverage but lower SAUCE Faithful scores. Distilled DeepSeek contains less out-of-scope details its full model, also reflected in its higher SAUCE Faithful . Smaller model may lack the capacity for interpretation, making it more likely to quote directly from the source text.
blocks.zh:
我们分析了这些摘要并确定了一些示范行为,以解释观察到的分数(详细的例子和分析见附录C节)。
误入歧途和不正确的信息会降低忠诚度,而省略主题细节则会降低覆盖范围. 我们注意到,GPT-4o汇总了全球和地方的信息;具体发言被压缩为更通俗的措词。 这与其高水平的SAUCE忠实但低水平的SAUCE覆盖一致. 相反地,Mistral7B和DeepSeek-R1倾向于保留具体的措辞,产生采掘——如摘要. 然而,幻觉更经常地出现,引入了在对话中从未出现的被误解的细节或信息. 这反映了SAUCE覆盖率较高,但SAUCE忠心分数较低. Distilled DeepSeek 包含较少的外在细节 其完整的模型, 也体现在它的更高的 SAUCE 信仰. 更小的模型可能缺乏解释能力,使其更可能直接从出处文本中引用.

blocks.en: Ultimately, the explainability of SAUCE transforms model evaluation from a ranking exercise into a diagnostic one. Because every score is tied to discrete facts, we know exactly why DeepSeek’s SAUCE Faithful is lower (it hallucinates non-existent conversational filler) and why GPT-4o’s SAUCE Coverage is lower (it over-compresses specific events into abstract concepts). This fact-based traceability allows developers to make highly informed trade-offs based on their specific application needs, such as choosing Mistral-7B for high-coverage extractive tasks or GPT-4o for SAUCE, high-faithfulness abstractive overviews.
blocks.zh: 归根结底,SAUCE的可解释性将模型评价从排名演练转变为诊断演练. 因为每个分数都和离散的事实有关, 我们知道 DeepSeek 的 SAUCE 信仰为何较低( 幻觉是不存在的谈话填充器), 这种基于事实的可追溯性使得开发者能够根据其具体的应用需要做出高度知情的取舍,例如选择Mistral-7B来完成高覆盖度的采掘任务,或者选择SPT-4o来完成SAUCE,高诚信抽象的概述.

blocks.en: 6.3 Human evaluation on summaries quality
blocks.zh: 6.3 关于摘要质量的人类评价

blocks.en: Table 6: Tau coefficient on human ranking of summaries compared with metrics. Notations as follow: Coef. - Kendall rank coefficient, SAUCE F - SAUCE Faithful , SAUCE C - SAUCE Coverage , SC - SummaC, Acc - Accuracy, Inf. - Informative.
blocks.zh: 表6:与衡量标准相比,摘要中人类排名的陶系数。 注释如下: Coef. - Kendall 排名系数,SAUCE F - SAUCE 忠诚,SAUCE C - SAUCE 覆盖范围,SC - SummaC,Acc - 准确性,Inf. - 信息化.

blocks.en: We also performed an internal evaluation on the metrics against human intuition. We asked 12 participants to rank a small set of summaries generated by the 4 LLMs, based on accuracy and informativeness, resulting in 132 rank pairs. We calculate the Kendall’s rank coefficient on the human ranked pairs and metrics ranked pairs in Table 6 . Pairs with less than a 0.05 score difference are treated as a tie. This is a difficult task and inter-conversation ranking pair agreement is only 60% between participants. In Table 6 , SAUCE Coverage is highly correlated with informativeness and SAUCE Faithful is most correlated to accuracy, indicating our metrics align with human judgment.
blocks.zh: 我们还对衡量人类直觉的标准进行了内部评估。 我们要求12名参与者根据准确性和信息性,对4个有限责任方案产生的一套小摘要进行排序,结果有132个排名对。 我们计算肯德尔在表6中人类排名对等和衡量对等的排名系数。 分数相差小于0.05分的对等作为平分. 这是一项艰巨的任务,参加方之间的相互对话排名对等协议仅为60%. 在表6中,SAUCE的覆盖范围与信息高度相关,而SAUCE的信仰与准确性最为相关,表明我们的衡量标准与人类判断一致。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 7. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We propose a set of fact-based metrics for cross-lingual conversational speech summarization. We define SAUCE Faithful and SAUCE Coverage metrics to measure the accuracy and coverage of summaries by extracting facts and evaluating their entailment. Experiments demonstrate that our metrics outperform existing metrics in conversation summarization with the ability to trace back how the score are given, particularly in the presence of ASR and MT errors. We also evaluate multiple LLMs, showing that our metrics provide analytical insights into LLM performance. Future work includes improving the consistency of the fact extractor to mitigate potential fluctuation and bias, and developing more robust entailment models for conversational text.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一套基于事实的衡量标准,用于跨语言对话的演讲总结。 我们界定了SAUCE 忠实和SAUCE覆盖度衡量标准,通过提取事实和评估其所涉内容来衡量摘要的准确性和覆盖面。 实验表明,在对话总结方面,我们的衡量标准优于现有衡量标准,能够追溯得分的方式,特别是在存在ASR和MT出错的情况下。 我们还评估多个有限责任公司,表明我们的衡量标准对有限责任公司的业绩提供了分析见解。 今后的工作包括改进事实提取器的一致性,以缓解潜在的波动和偏见,并发展更强有力的对话文本引领模式。

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: The entailment model used in this study (DeBERTa-v3) was pre-trained on general text data and is not specifically tailored for conversational data, for which no dedicated entailment model currently exists. Future work involves fine-tuning DeBERTa-v3 for conversational entailment. However, this requires substantial amounts of annotated data that are presently unavailable.
blocks.zh: 本研究(DEBERTa-v3)中使用的引领模型在一般文本数据方面经过了预先培训,没有专门针对对话数据,目前还没有专门的引领模型。 今后的工作包括微调DeBERTa-v3用于对话。 但是,这需要大量附加说明的数据,而目前没有这些数据。

blocks.en: Regarding fact extraction, our experiments relied solely on GPT-4o, which may be excessive for this task and carries the disadvantage of requiring API access, preventing offline deployment. Given that different LLMs exhibit distinct behaviors, future studies should evaluate various fact extractors and their potential biases. Our next step is to identify smaller LLMs for the pipeline and distill them using outputs from high-performing teacher models.
blocks.zh: 关于取出事实,我们的实验完全依靠GPT-4o,这可能对这项任务过分,具有要求API进入的缺点,防止线下部署。 鉴于不同的法学硕士课程表现出不同的行为,今后的研究应评价各种事实提取因素及其潜在的偏见。 我们下一步是确定用于管道的较小的LLMs,并利用优秀的教师模型的输出来提炼.

blocks.en: For our human evaluation of summary quality, the sample size was limited by resource constraints. Feedback from annotators indicated that reviewing long, transcribed conversations against summaries is exceptionally demanding. The inherent difficulty of systemic human cross-validation for such automatic pipelines poses challenges in precisely validating the overall performance.
blocks.zh: 就我们对简要质量的人力评价而言,抽样规模受到资源限制的限制。 注释员的反馈表明,对照摘要审查长长的、转录的谈话要求特别高。 对这种自动管道进行系统的人类交叉验证的固有困难,给准确验证总体性能带来了挑战。

blocks.en: 9 Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 9 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
Due to the use of LLMs, ASR and MT, our metric can be subject to the bias of those models.
SAUCE provides a chain of artifacts so that a user can potentially discover any underlying bias in the final scores.
All audio recordings used in this study have been previously published.
Informed consent was obtained from all participants included in the study.
blocks.zh:
由于使用LLMS、ASR和MT,我们的衡量标准可能受到这些模型的偏向。
SAUCE提供一连串的文物,这样用户就可以潜在地发现最终分数中的任何内在偏差.
本研究报告中使用的所有录音资料以前都已出版。
研究中的所有参与者都表示知情同意。

blocks.zh: 附录A 扩大的跨部门评价计量

blocks.en: This section presents the comprehensive scoring breakdown for the evaluation frameworks discussed in this work. Table 7 details the performance of SAUCE alongside established NLI-based and LLM-as-a-judge baselines—FineSurE, G-EVAL, FENICE, and SummaC—across Arabic, Mandarin, Russian, and Spanish. These results highlight the comparative stability of fact-based metrics when subject to the cascading noise of cascaded ASR with MT. While traditional metrics often struggle to generalize across diverse linguistic structures, the raw data support our observation that SAUCE provides a more consistent reflection of information loss and factual accuracy in conversational telephony speech.
blocks.zh: 本节列出这项工作所讨论评价框架的综合评分细目。 表7详细列出了SCUCE与基于NLI和LLM-as-judge的既定基线——FineSurE、G-EVAL、FENICE和SummaC——跨越阿拉伯语、普通话、俄语和西班牙语——的绩效。 这些结果突出了基于事实的衡量标准在与MT相接的级联ASR的相接噪声下相对的稳定性。 虽然传统的衡量标准往往难以概括各种语言结构,但原始数据支持我们的意见,即SAUCE更一致地反映了对话电话语音中的信息损失和事实准确性。

blocks.en: Appendix C Detail analysis on summaries generated by various LLMs
blocks.zh: 附录C 各种法学硕士课程产生的摘要的详细分析

blocks.en:
We analyzed the summaries and presented some examples of SAUCE Coverage facts and summary sentences in Table 10 . We highlighted correct information in blue, incorrect in red, and over-interpretation in orange.
As discussed in earlier section, GPT-4o generate abstractive summary with higher accuracy, while Mistral generates extractive summary with specifics, with more error. For Fact 1, Mistral7B got the incorrect name, but describes all the sports activities involved. GPT-4o got the name correct, but generalized all activities to “sports". DeepSeek models mentioned part of the sport activities, but misinterpreted and included extra information that is not in the conversation.
For Fact 2, GPT-4o generalized it to “securing a green card" without giving much detail. Other models correctly describe the stage of the green card process, but Mistral7B does not name what process it is. DeepSeek provides a reason for approval that is not found in conversation. Misspelling and wrong information leads to lower SAUCE Faithful and missing the subject detail leads to lower SAUCE Coverage , this explaining the lower SAUCE Faithful for Mistral7B and DeepSeek, and lower SAUCE Coverage for GPT-4o. This explains the scores on the models.
blocks.zh:
我们分析了摘要,并在表10中举出一些关于SCUCE报道事实和摘要句子的例子。 我们以蓝色、红色和橙色突出正确信息。
如上一节所讨论,GPT-4o生成更精确的抽象摘要,而Mistral生成有具体内容的采掘摘要,出现更多的错误. 事实1,米斯特拉7 B得到了错误的名字,但描述了所有涉及的体育活动. GPT-4o的命名正确,但将所有活动都概括为"运动". DeepSeek模型提到了部分体育活动,但被曲解并包括了谈话中没有的额外信息.
GPT-4o将它概括为“保障绿卡”, 其他模型正确描述了绿卡过程的阶段,但Mistral7B并没有命名它是什么过程. DeepSeek提供了一个在谈话中找不到的认可理由. 误入歧途和错误的信息导致更低的SAUCE信仰和缺失主题细节导致更低的SAUCE覆盖,这解释了更低的SAUCE信仰为Mistral7B和DeepSeek,更低的SAUCE覆盖为GPT-4o. 这解释了模型上的分数.
